purpose: Human readability and accurate provenance are commitments of this programme. The companion explains its mathematics, credits the human sources it uses, and records the scope and limits of the source audit.

evidence_levels.lexical_scan: Mechanical inspection of exact text bytes for specified patterns; not full mathematical reading.
evidence_levels.prior_recorded_reading: A previous reading/verification receipt is reported at its stated scope; it is not a fresh re-execution.
evidence_levels.full_source_reading: Claimed only when a separate source-specific report supplies its exact coverage. This inventory makes no whole-corpus full-reading claim.

completed_inventory.current_bibliography_scope: All five keys refer to internal programme material. This is not a claim that the historical archive contains no human attribution.
completed_inventory.validation_scope: Lexical extraction and source-location validation only; not mathematical reading, historical priority adjudication, or source-applicability review.

acquired_transcript.coverage: One acquired published current parent chain, as published; not all private sessions or historical branches.
acquired_transcript.meaning_of_nonempty_record: A nonempty message object, not a guarantee of nonempty textual content; an attachment-only user record has empty text.
acquired_transcript.attachment_boundary: A mentioned attachment or sandbox path does not supply its file bytes. No redacted payload was recovered by the acquisition.
acquired_transcript.this_inventory_reading_scope: The acquisition coverage and verification receipts were read; the entire 5,349-message text was not reread for this inventory.

separate_historical_work_reported.scope: Counts read from sibling audit receipts, not recomputed as part of this corpus inventory.
separate_historical_work_reported.caveat: Search is not full reading; selected source passages have their own separate review scopes. Counts overlap the current and transcript material and must not be added as disjoint coverage.

remaining_scope.boundary: Other relevant local research roots beyond the selected modern multilingual archive
remaining_scope.evidence: The canonical route enumerates general Chatnotes, Soc, Split Zero, Mock, globalization-NTE, globalization-CUE and CUE-Mellin roots. Its August snapshot reports 251,407 local file records and 459 canonical publication units.
remaining_scope.next_action: Query the existing canonical source graph for actual links to the Split-Zero programme and inspect the returned dependency sources. Record unlinked material as outside the research-use boundary; mere library ownership is not a citation dependency.

remaining_scope.boundary: Human literature used after the legacy bibliography/source ledgers
remaining_scope.evidence: The three principal literature ledgers have latest dated entries on 30 August. The separate bibliography has 109 entries and was modified 12 September. The recorded research-library inventory has 55,470 file records and 10,100 canonical publication units.
remaining_scope.next_action: Reconcile subsequent notes, source reviews, uploads and web citations against actual human works and editions; preserve author, translator, editor, exposé author, source-cites-source and direct-use roles separately.

remaining_scope.boundary: Unnamed mathematical dependencies, ambiguous eponyms and applicable theorem statements
remaining_scope.evidence: A finite name lexicon misses unnamed results, aliases and spelling variants. A name occurrence does not establish a paper used or an imported theorem.
remaining_scope.next_action: Read the relevant derivations and source passages to attach each substantive use to its exact hypotheses and locator. Separate locally proved specialization, cited background, historical mention and actual imported result.

remaining_scope.boundary: Changing mathematical successor and public-entry integration
remaining_scope.evidence: Accepted726 successor published as DOI10.5281/zenodo.22803503; companion updated to that edition. Earlier mechanical scan remains pinned to the692 predecessor.
remaining_scope.next_action: Keep accepted mathematical successors and newly used human sources current; publish the separately sealed additive exposition package through the same publication owner.

privacy: No private username, local absolute path, raw conversation passage, private assignment text or private source-map payload is included in these public coverage files.
nonclaims: No whole-library or whole-session completeness claim.
No attribution to a human is inferred from a machine account or a filename.
No new proof audit, Lean run, remote publication, or mathematical acceptance is claimed.
An eponym hit is not a verified author or theorem dependency.

accepted_successor.reference_convention: R14/R09 page references are to the preserved692 predecessor; R726 labels identify the accepted successor.

historical_maps.scope: Mechanical search of recoverable decoded text; checksum/restoration records remain unresolved. No claim that every decoded body matches an original declared byte hash. No binary mathematical reading or hidden-payload recovery.

additional_discovery.overlap_warning: Scopes overlap; do not add as disjoint coverage. Mechanical scanning is not full mathematical reading.
